name: second-brain-memory
description: Persistent memory for Claude Code over your own markdown notes: registers the sqlite-graph-memory MCP server (vector + wikilink-graph recall on plain SQLite). Separate from the skills plugin because the embeddings extra pulls about 2 GB of torch on first start.

author.name: Anton Dziatkovskii / Palo Alto AI Research Lab

index_dir.title: Index directory
index_dir.description: The folder `sgm-index` wrote for your notes (BRAIN_INDEX_DIR). Build it once with: uvx --python 3.12 --from 'sqlite-graph-memory[embeddings]' sgm-index <your notes folder>
